subject: CloudStream: pain/goals recap + proposed decision playbook
messages:
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>
To: Emmett Riley <emmett@cloudstream.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 15 Nov 2026 15:08:00 -0800
Subject: CloudStream: pain/goals recap + proposed decision playbook

Hi Emmett / Natalie —

Thanks again for taking time today. Quick recap and a proposed decision playbook so we have alignment on who does what over the next six weeks. I captured the things we agreed on and a few asks to keep the process moving.

Call highlights (your priorities)
- Primary pain: production costs and latency spikes on batch inference for ad-hoc analytics pipelines (esp. windows >8k tokens).
- Secondary pain: inconsistent throughput during concurrency spikes and lack of easy fallbacks for lower-cost model variants.
- Business goal: reduce per-query inference cost by 30% while keeping 95th-pctl latency below 350ms for 2k token average requests.
- Success criteria: quantifiable cost/latency delta vs current baseline + an internal pilot with 2 production teams by end of Q1.

Key stakeholders you mentioned
- Emmett Riley (AI Platform lead) — technical decision-maker
- Natalie Zhou (Product/PoC sponsor) — defines success metrics
- Simone (Legal) and procurement@cloudstream.com — procurement & contract

Proposed Decision Playbook (mutual action plan)
1) Technical evaluation kickoff — Week 1 (Nov 16–20) — Redwood provides a short spike: performance baseline run + config recommendations. Owner: Redwood (Tessa/Aditya). Deliverable: baseline report + suggested config draft.
2) Security & compliance sync — Week 2 (Nov 23–27) — share SOC2 scoping, SSO requirements, and network diagram. Owner: CloudStream (Simone / infra) + Redwood (security doc). Deliverable: security checklist and evidence items.
3) Pilot setup & test run — Week 3–4 (Nov 30–Dec 11) — Dedicated trial environment for two teams, sample traffic, and failure-mode testing. Owner: CloudStream infra + Redwood solutions. Deliverable: pilot report with cost/latency numbers.
4) Procurement & commercial review — Week 5 (Dec 14–18) — finalize terms and commit level. Owner: CloudStream procurement + Redwood sales. Deliverable: draft SOW / PO.
5) Exec alignment & go/no-go — Week 6 (Dec 21–23) — final decision based on pilot. Owner: Natalie / Emmett. Deliverable: signed commitment or defined next steps.

Open asks from Redwood (to help scope):
- Can Simone (Legal) and cloud procurement inbox be looped in this week? Procurement typically needs a draft SOW.
- Can you share an anonymized traffic sample (1–2 days) or token distribution so we can run an initial cost model?
- Do you have an existing SSO / IdP diagram we can reference (we can provide sample SSO integration doc)?

Attachments: redwood-map-cloudstream-v1.xlsx (initial milestone table).

Next steps
- I’ll run the baseline spike Monday and share results by EOD Wednesday.
- Please confirm stakeholders I listed and introduce Simone/procurement so we can queue the security review.

Thanks — looking forward to driving this forward.

Best,
Tessa Morgan
Enterprise Sales — Redwood Inference
Mobile: +1 (415) 555-0149

Thanks Tessa — this is great and aligned with our internal thinking. Quick notes:

- Confirm stakeholders: Simone Kapoor (Legal) is now on the thread (she prefers direct intro to the vendor legal contact).
- Procurement: forwarding to procurement@cloudstream.com — they’ll want a rough SOW and estimated spend band.
- For the traffic sample, I can coordinate an anonymized token distribution export — will send that by Tue morning.

One ask from my side: can Redwood include an option for a 30-day dedicated trial (pre-prod slice) as part of the pilot? That would let us test concurrency patterns with realistic load.

I’ll wait for your baseline report. If the numbers look good we’ll aim to complete procurement review by mid-December.

—Emmett
Emmett Riley

On Sun, Nov 15, 2026 at 3:08 PM Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai> wrote:
> [original message]
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>
To: Emmett Riley <emmett@cloudstream.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Simone Kapoor <simone@cloudstream.com>, procurement@cloudstream.com
Date: Mon, 16 Nov 2026 09:30:00 -0800
Subject: CloudStream: baseline results + updated playbook and attachments

Hi all —

Per our timeline I ran the quick baseline spike and attached an initial workbook with the performance summary and proposed config knobs. High-level takeaways:
- Using the sample token distribution Emmett provided, our recommended setup (quantized v2 + prefix caching + per-route batching) estimates a ~28–35% cost reduction on typical queries and 95th-pctl latency of ~320ms on the 2k token average with a small tail we can reduce with smarter KV cache tuning.
- Concurrency stress: when synthetic concurrency >75 qps we see latency degradation unless we allocate an isolated pool or enable strict request shaping.

Updated mutual action playbook (attached sheet + summary)
- Week 1 (Nov 16–20): Baseline report (done) — Deliverable: redwood-map-cloudstream-v1.xlsx (attached).
- Week 2 (Nov 23–27): Security & SSO evidence — Redwood will share SOC2 extract and default retention plus a sample SSO integration guide (attached: redwood-sso-arch.pdf). Action: Simone to confirm any additional evidence.
- Week 3–4 (Nov 30–Dec 11): Pilot provisioning — Redwood to provision a 30-day dedicated trial instance (per Emmett’s ask) scoped to two teams. We’ll provide a pilot runbook and success checklist.
- Week 5 (Dec 14–18): Commercial review — Draft SOW and illustrative pricing bands to be delivered by Redwood.
- Week 6 (Dec 21–23): Decision review — Exec sign-off.

Open items / asks (action owners)
- Simone / procurement: please confirm legal procurement timeline and whether a master services agreement or PO is preferred.
- Emmett: confirm target traffic windows for pilot (peak hours) so we can replicate concurrency.
- Natalie: confirm two pilot teams and their owners.

Attachments included: redwood-map-cloudstream-v1.xlsx, redwood-sso-arch.pdf. I also uploaded a living playbook doc: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1fAKEExAMPLE-link-playbook

If that looks good I’ll raise the provisioning ticket and schedule a security sync for next week.

Thanks,
Tessa
Enterprise Sales — Redwood Inference

From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 18 Nov 2026 11:15:00 -0800
Subject: Re: CloudStream: pain/goals recap + proposed decision playbook

Looping back internally. Two quick points for the playbook before we share the commercial:
1) Pricing option: recommend we surface two commercial bands — (A) pay-as-you-go hosted with dynamic routing and (B) 30-day dedicated trial followed by reserved capacity commit (12-mo). Emmett asked for the dedicated trial — we should include an illustrative delta vs hosted.
2) Risk note: if they need sub-350ms 95th under sustained 100+ qps we should propose an isolated GPU pool in the pilot. That impacts cost but keeps the SLO realistic.

Marissa — can you prepare the illustrative pricing table and short SOW template this afternoon? I’ll sync with Tessa on the language for the trial.

Thanks,
Aditya
Solutions Engineering — Redwood Inference
